# Abeta KMP Kit — SwiftPM Distribution

> Direct-URL Swift Package Manager distribution for Abeta KMP Kit Apple Release XCFrameworks (`AbetaSduiKit` for iOS 15+, `AbetaWatchKit` for watchOS 9+) and companion SwiftUI renderers (`AbetaSduiSwiftUI`, `AbetaWatchSwiftUI`). Zero credentials required.

## Package Manifest & Sources

- [Package.swift](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp-spm/main/Package.swift): 4-product SwiftPM manifest (`AbetaSduiKit`, `AbetaWatchKit`, `AbetaWatchSwiftUI`, `AbetaSduiSwiftUI`)
- [Sources/AbetaWatchSwiftUI/AbetaWatchSwiftUI.swift](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp-spm/main/Sources/AbetaWatchSwiftUI/AbetaWatchSwiftUI.swift): Ready-made watchOS SwiftUI renderer (`AbetaWatchGlanceView`, `AbetaWatchNavigationRoot`, `AbetaWatchMetricRow`, `AbetaWatchStatusBadge`, `AbetaWatchActionButton`)
- [Sources/AbetaSduiSwiftUI/AbetaSduiSwiftUI.swift](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp-spm/main/Sources/AbetaSduiSwiftUI/AbetaSduiSwiftUI.swift): iOS SwiftUI `AbetaSduiHostView` wrapper
- [SHA256SUMS.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp-spm/main/SHA256SUMS.txt): Verified SHA-256 checksums for all `.xcframework.zip` and source release archives
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp-spm/main/README.md): Xcode & `Package.swift` integration guide

## Upstream Platform Repositories

- [Abeta KMP Kit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/llms.txt): Core KMP SDK (`v0.7.0`), 23 canonical SDUI snippets (incl. `custom_slot` & `graph_canvas`), version-gated ETag/304 caching, SSE delta streaming, Room 3 database, & Apple/Wear OS host glue
- [Abeta Dynamic Layout Engine](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/layout-engine/main/llms.txt): Multi-tenant SDUI layout CMS & Visual Studio
- [Abeta SDUI Domain BFF](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/sdui-bff/main/llms.txt): Standalone Go BFF powering vertical apps
